cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: Performances of huge emotional scope and intense drama. The Guardian

sections.title: Welcome
body: Zlata Chochieva returns to Vivo Performing Arts following her triumphant debut in 2025, when her sold-out recital announced an artist of taste, passion, and distinction. For her much- anticipated return, she shares with us music of overwhelming emotional intensity, from the volcanic fury of Beethoven to the supernatural terror of Ravel. She’s exactly the pianist to navigate this storm: fierce and ferocious where the music demands it, yet capable of an almost unearthly delicacy in more tender passages.

sections.title: Today's Program
sections.lead: Returns after sold-out 2025 debut. Beethoven Appassionata Op. 57, Cowell Aeolian Harp, Ravel Gaspard de la nuit, Saint-Sans Op. 52 No. 3, Brahms Sonata No. 3 Op. 5.
